title: Automate the complete UI to sync to downloaded-content flow
description:
Coverage gap identified during Astra review of main 3b2c4f5 against SPEC.md §11. This is a verification gap, rather than a separately reproduced product defect.

## Current coverage

server/e2e_test.go:47 polls the engine directly rather than observing /sync. Archive validation at line 68 checks only opening bytes. The browser portion is expressly manual at line 23. The repository therefore lacks a repeatable automated check of the full UI → API → realtime sync → retrieved-content contract.

Existing Go tests passed during review (cached results). Browser MCP access was denied, so no fresh browser or public-torrent E2E verification was performed.

## Acceptance criteria

- Run a built embedded binary against an isolated temporary configuration and download directory.
- Drive the actual Vue UI to add a legal pinned torrent fixture and observe metadata/progress and downloaded files through the real realtime connection.
- Retrieve a downloaded file and verify its content, not only response status or nonempty output.
- Download a directory ZIP, open it with an archive reader, and verify expected entries and content.
- Make the test reproducible through a Take command and document prerequisites, network gating, fixture provenance, and cleanup.
- Never touch the server's live downloads or configuration.

## References

SPEC.md §10 core flow and §11 testing strategy.
server/e2e_test.go:23,47,68.

## Completion evidence

Added a pinned Playwright/fflate harness under .dev/e2e, driven by ./dev.ts e2e. It builds/runs an isolated embedded binary, submits a pinned CC0 local magnet through the real Omni bar, observes a real SSE connection and intermediate Vue progress, compares exact file bytes, removes the torrent card, exercises keyboard folder controls and validates ZIP entries/content. Added opt-in public Big Buck Bunny poster checks with pinned SHA-256, safe cleanup of its shared-piece sparse neighbor, package/browser setup flags and documentation. ./dev.ts ci includes deterministic browser E2E; GitHub Actions has a separate one-line Take browser step. Updated SPEC/agent docs and upgraded the old network-gated Go smoke test from DHT-only Sintel metadata and ZIP magic checks to explicit metainfo plus poster and full ZIP content verification.

Final validation: ./dev.ts ci passed (type checks, embedded build, full Go suite, deterministic browser E2E); ./dev.ts e2e --skip-build --public-fixture passed; go test -tags e2e -run E2E ./server/... passed (6.512s). Intentional browser-start failure and SIGTERM both exited nonzero, terminated the isolated app and removed scratch data. Formatting/diff checks passed. The original legacy Sintel smoke timed out; the upgraded test passes without requiring public-swarm metadata. New E2E dependencies audit clean. Production app/config/downloads were not changed.
